summary: PR 7518 added a CI mechanism to register required Azure resource providers before e2e tests. It merged on 2026-10-11 with no recorded review.
proposed: The body proposes an optional repository-root .required-resource-providers.json, in the same format as .required-features.json, listing provider namespaces per module path, with avm/res/hybrid-container-service/provisioned-cluster-instance as the first consumer.
changed: The deployment action registers providers right after feature registration and before token replacement, validation or deployment. It skips registered providers, waits on existing Registering operations, registers NotRegistered/Unregistered ones once, and fails explicitly on invalid declarations, identity mismatches, approval-required or unknown states, errors and timeouts. Missing or unrelated declarations and WhatIf are no-ops without Azure calls.
shipped: Merged 2026-10-11 as commit f006e66, touching .github/actions, .required-resource-providers.json, utilities/pipelines and utilities/tests. The initial consumer is avm/res/hybrid-container-service/provisioned-cluster-instance with 13 prerequisites.
